name: Jace, Wielder of Mysteries
oracle_text:
If you would draw a card while your library has no cards in it, you win the game instead.
+1: Target player mills two cards. Draw a card.
−8: Draw seven cards. Then if your library has no cards in it, you win the game.
blocked_sentences: If you would draw a card while your library has no cards in it, you win the game instead.

needs.what: A player-wide static replacement of the *attempt* to draw from an empty library -- the Laboratory Maniac / Jace, Wielder of Mysteries effect. It must sit in the same place `replace_draw` does (`engine/replacements.py`, which every post-opening-hand draw passes through one card at a time) but fire on the branch `replace_draw` never reaches: the case where the library is empty and no card can be moved. Instead of multiplying the draw it replaces it outright, so the draw never happens, the 104.3c/704.5b "will lose" flag that `primitives.draw` sets is never set, and the drawing player wins the game immediately. Suggested spelling: a new player-wide static effect, e.g. `replace_empty_draw` with `affects_player` and an outcome of `win`, alongside the existing `replace_draw` in `PLAYER_WIDE_STATIC_EFFECTS` and `vocabulary.STATIC_EFFECTS`. It must be a real replacement read wherever a draw is attempted (a spell's `draw` op, the draw step, a `draw` rider on another card's effect), and it must survive the source leaving only in the sense that it applies while the permanent is on the battlefield -- i.e. an ordinary static, not a one-shot.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `replace_draw` is the only member of the draw-replacement family and it is a pure multiplier: the loader (`cards/loader/__init__.py`) requires `draw_multiplier` and explicitly refuses a value below 2 ("1 replaces a draw with itself and 0 draws nothing, which is a different effect"), and it accepts nothing beside `affects_player`, `draw_multiplier`, `except_first_in_draw_step` and a `condition` -- there is no key on it that can name a different outcome, and the packet's own note says a replacement that does something other than draw more cards is still a gap. Nothing else in `static_effects` touches drawing: `skip_draw_step` removes the draw step rather than replacing a draw, and `replace_life_gain`/`replace_life_loss`/`replace_token_creation` are the same multiplier shape on other events. `win_game` exists only as an effect op (Halo Fountain, Luck Bobblehead both run it inside an activated ability's `effects`), so it can only be reached by something that resolves, and it is not available to a static. It cannot be approximated as a triggered ability either: `trigger_events` has `draw`, but that event fires only after a card actually reaches a hand, and the printed line is precisely about the case where no card can be drawn -- `engine/primitives.py` treats an empty library as an *attempt* to draw, setting the player's "will lose" flag (704.5b) with no draw event at all, so a `draw` trigger would never fire and the state-based loss would still be checked and applied before any such trigger could win the game. There is likewise no `would_lose_the_game`, `draws_from_empty_library` or similar trigger event to hang it on, and `condition_keys` has nothing that a static can use to intercept an event.
